meta.title: AI Compute Demand Monitor
meta.subtitle: Demand signals, physical capacity, and the economics of AI infrastructure

source_health.detail: VAST_HOST_API_KEY is not configured (host keys only)

meta.disclaimer: Scenario analysis, not investment advice. Project-level economics are not company guidance or consolidated forecasts.

scenario_labels.bear: Slower demand, lower pricing, higher operating cost
scenario_labels.base: Central adoption, pricing, and cost assumptions
scenario_labels.bull: Faster demand, stronger pricing, better operating leverage

assumptions.label: Capital spend basis
assumptions.description: Latest reported annual capital expenditure when available; otherwise the disclosed model fallback.

assumptions.label: AI infrastructure share
assumptions.description: Share of total capital expenditure allocated to the modeled AI data-center project.

assumptions.label: Accelerated-compute share
assumptions.description: Portion of project capital assigned to GPUs, accelerator systems, and supporting compute hardware.

assumptions.label: All-in accelerator cost
assumptions.description: Accelerator plus allocated server, networking, installation, and commissioning cost.

assumptions.label: Annual project revenue
assumptions.description: Annual incremental revenue or internal economic value attributable to the modeled capacity.

assumptions.label: Revenue per GPU-hour
assumptions.description: Blended external price or internal value realized for an occupied accelerator hour.

assumptions.label: Non-power operating cost
assumptions.description: Labor, networking, software, facilities, and other cash operating costs excluding electricity.

assumptions.label: Electricity cost
assumptions.description: Delivered electricity price before multiplying by power usage effectiveness.

assumptions.label: Power usage effectiveness
assumptions.description: Total facility power divided by IT equipment power.

assumptions.label: Accelerator system draw
assumptions.description: Average occupied power draw of an accelerator and its allocated host components.

assumptions.label: Depreciable life
assumptions.description: Straight-line useful life used for accelerator and project depreciation.

assumptions.label: Annual revenue growth
assumptions.description: Annual growth in project revenue after the first modeled year.

assumptions.label: Cash tax rate
assumptions.description: Marginal cash tax rate applied to positive project EBIT.

assumptions.label: Maintenance capex
assumptions.description: Recurring capital expenditure required to sustain the project fleet and facilities.

assumptions.label: Discount rate
assumptions.description: Unlevered nominal hurdle rate used for project NPV.

assumptions.label: Residual value
assumptions.description: End-of-project proceeds from reusable facilities, networking, and hardware.

metrics.label: Project IRR
metrics.formula: Discount rate that sets the modeled unlevered project cash flows, including residual value, to zero.

metrics.label: Data-center ROIC
metrics.formula: Year-one NOPAT divided by modeled AI project capital.

metrics.label: GPU utilization
metrics.formula: Annual project revenue divided by GPU-equivalents × 8,760 hours × blended value per GPU-hour.

metrics.label: Payback period
metrics.formula: First fractional year in which cumulative unlevered after-tax cash flow becomes positive.

metrics.label: Depreciation-adjusted return
metrics.formula: Year-one NOPAT plus non-cash depreciation, divided by modeled AI project capital.

metrics.label: Marginal operating margin
metrics.formula: Incremental project revenue less non-power operating cost, electricity, and depreciation, divided by revenue.
